prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1497; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle spasm and reduced range of motion. Mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the presenting symptoms are a plausible result of that force. Physical examination and imaging findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient's history or available records.

Care consisted of 20 visits including manual therapy, a home stretching and strengthening program, and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Treatment followed a usual and expected course, with frequency tapering as the patient's pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges for the same procedure on the same date.

At the most recent visit the patient reported substantial improvement, with near-normal range of motion and minimal residual discomfort. Discharge from active care is recommended, with a home exercise program to be continued independently.
